name: Smartlead
summary: Cold email platform with unlimited mailboxes, AI warm-up, lead finding and deliverability infrastructure.
description: Smartlead sends cold email at scale across unlimited mailboxes with AI warm-up, and adds SmartProspect for verified leads, AI agents, dedicated sending servers and an AI dialer. It is used by agencies and outbound teams. A free trial is offered; plan prices were partly readable on the pricing page. The company publishes case studies and free tools for email authentication and deliverability. Its site offered 50% off the first month during this check.

howToUse.title: Open Smartlead
howToUse.description: Open Smartlead and start the trial that is offered. Agencies and outbound teams use it when Smartlead sends cold email at scale.

howToUse.title: Set mailboxes and leads
howToUse.description: Add unlimited mailboxes with AI warm-up. Use SmartProspect for verified leads and SmartAgents as the outreach agents.

howToUse.title: Add servers and the dialer
howToUse.description: Turn on dedicated sending servers, then call with the AI dialer. Read the case studies the company publishes.

howToUse.title: Check authentication and pricing
howToUse.description: Use the SPF, DKIM and DMARC checkers for email authentication and deliverability. Open pricing: prices were partly readable, and during this check the site offered 50% off the first month.
